package org.flatton.client

import org.flatton.types.*
import borg.trikeshed.lib.*
import borg.trikeshed.net.http.*
import borg.trikeshed.parse.json.*

class WasmCouchClient(
    private val baseUrl: String = "http://127.0.0.1:5984" // Default to localhost
) : CouchClient {
    private val headers = mapOf(
        HttpHeaderName("Content-Type") to HttpHeaderValue("application/json"),
        HttpHeaderName("Accept") to HttpHeaderValue("application/json")
    )

    private suspend fun <T> handleResponse(response: HttpResponse, onSuccess: (String) -> T): T {
        if (!response.isSuccess) {
            val errorBody = response.body.toString()
            val error = try { CouchError.fromJson(errorBody) } catch (e: Exception) { null }
            throw CouchException("CouchDB request failed with status ${response.status.value}", error?.error, error?.reason)
        }
        return onSuccess(response.body.toString())
    }

    override suspend fun getDatabaseInfo(dbName: DatabaseName): CouchDatabaseInfo {
        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.GET,
            path = HttpRequestPath("/${dbName.value}"),
            headers = headers
        ).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { CouchDatabaseInfo.fromJson(it) }
    }

    override suspend fun createDatabase(dbName: DatabaseName): CouchResponse {
        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.PUT,
            path = HttpRequestPath("/${dbName.value}"),
            headers = headers
        ).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { CouchResponse.fromJson(it) }
    }

    override suspend fun deleteDatabase(dbName: DatabaseName): CouchResponse {
        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.DELETE,
            path = HttpRequestPath("/${dbName.value}"),
            headers = headers
        ).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { CouchResponse.fromJson(it) }
    }

    override suspend fun getDocument(dbName: DatabaseName, docId: DocumentId, rev: RevisionId?): CouchDocument {
        val path = "/${dbName.value}/${docId.value}" + if (rev != null) "?rev=${rev.value}" else ""
        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.GET,
            path = HttpRequestPath(path),
            headers = headers
        ).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { CouchDocumentAdapter.fromJson(it) }
    }

    override suspend fun createDocument(dbName: DatabaseName, doc: CouchDocument, docId: DocumentId?): CouchResponse {
        val method = if (docId != null) HttpMethod.PUT else HttpMethod.POST
        val path = if (docId != null) "/${dbName.value}/${docId.value}" else "/${dbName.value}"

        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = method,
            path = HttpRequestPath(path),
            headers = headers,
            body = CouchDocumentAdapter.toJson(doc)
        ).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { CouchResponse.fromJson(it) }
    }

    override suspend fun updateDocument(dbName: DatabaseName, doc: CouchDocument): CouchResponse {
        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.PUT,
            path = HttpRequestPath("/${dbName.value}/${doc._id.value}"),
            headers = headers,
            body = CouchDocumentAdapter.toJson(doc)
        ).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { CouchResponse.fromJson(it) }
    }

    override suspend fun deleteDocument(dbName: DatabaseName, docId: DocumentId, rev: RevisionId): CouchResponse {
        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.DELETE,
            path = HttpRequestPath("/${dbName.value}/${docId.value}?rev=${rev.value}"),
            headers = headers
        ).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { CouchResponse.fromJson(it) }
    }

    override suspend fun copyDocument(dbName: DatabaseName, fromId: DocumentId, toId: DocumentId, toRev: RevisionId?): CouchResponse {
        val destination = toId.value + if (toRev != null) "?rev=${toRev.value}" else ""
        val copyHeaders = headers + (HttpHeaderName("Destination") to HttpHeaderValue(destination))
        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.COPY,
            path = HttpRequestPath("/${dbName.value}/${fromId.value}"),
            headers = copyHeaders
        ).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { CouchResponse.fromJson(it) }
    }

    override suspend fun bulkDocs(dbName: DatabaseName, docs: Series<CouchDocument>, allOrNothing: Boolean): Series<CouchResponse> {
        val body = JsonImpl.stringify(mapOf(
            "docs" to docs.play.map { JsonImpl.parse(CouchDocumentAdapter.toJson(it)) },
            "all_or_nothing" to allOrNothing
        ))
        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.POST,
            path = HttpRequestPath("/${dbName.value}/_bulk_docs"),
            headers = headers,
            body = body
        ).send()
        return handleResponse(response) {
            val list = JsonImpl.parse(it) as List<Map<String, Any?>>
            list.map { item ->
                CouchResponse(
                    ok = item["ok"] as? Boolean ?: (item["error"] == null),
                    id = (item["id"] as? String)?.let { idVal -> DocumentId(idVal) },
                    rev = (item["rev"] as? String)?.let { revVal -> RevisionId(revVal) },
                    error = item["error"] as? String,
                    reason = item["reason"] as? String
                )
            }.toSeries()
        }
    }

    override suspend fun getDesignDocument(dbName: DatabaseName, docId: DocumentId): CouchDesignDocument {
        val response = getDocument(dbName, docId)
        return CouchDesignDocumentAdapter.fromJson(CouchDocumentAdapter.toJson(response))
    }

    override suspend fun saveDesignDocument(dbName: DatabaseName, doc: CouchDesignDocument): CouchResponse {
        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.PUT,
            path = HttpRequestPath("/${dbName.value}/${doc.id.asDocId().value}"),
            headers = headers,
            body = CouchDesignDocumentAdapter.toJson(doc)
        ).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { CouchResponse.fromJson(it) }
    }

    override suspend fun <K, V> queryView(dbName: DatabaseName, designDocId: DocumentId, viewName: ViewName, params: ViewQueryParams): ViewResponse<K, V> {
        val path = "/${dbName.value}/_design/${designDocId.value}/_view/${viewName.value}${params.toQueryString()}"
        val response = HttpRequest(method = HttpMethod.GET, path = HttpRequestPath(path), headers = headers).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { ViewResponseAdapter.fromJson(it) }
    }

    override suspend fun getSecurity(dbName: DatabaseName): CouchSecurity {
        val response = HttpRequest(method = HttpMethod.GET, path = HttpRequestPath("/${dbName.value}/_security"), headers = headers).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { CouchSecurity.fromJson(it) }
    }

    override suspend fun setSecurity(dbName: DatabaseName, security: CouchSecurity): CouchResponse {
        val response = HttpRequest(method = HttpMethod.PUT, path = HttpRequestPath("/${dbName.value}/_security"), headers = headers, body = security.toJson()).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { CouchResponse.fromJson(it) }
    }
}

import borg.trikeshed.lib.*
import borg.trikeshed.net.http.*
import borg.trikeshed.parse.json.*

class WasmCouchClient(
    private val baseUrl: String = "http://127.0.0.1:5984" // Default to localhost
) : CouchClient {
    private val headers = mapOf(
        HttpHeaderName("Content-Type") to HttpHeaderValue("application/json"),
        HttpHeaderName("Accept") to HttpHeaderValue("application/json")
    )

    private suspend fun <T> handleResponse(response: HttpResponse, onSuccess: (String) -> T): T {
        if (!response.isSuccess) {
            val errorBody = response.body.toString()
            val error = try { CouchError.fromJson(errorBody) } catch (e: Exception) { null }
            throw CouchException("CouchDB request failed with status ${response.status.value}", error?.error, error?.reason)
        }
        return onSuccess(response.body.toString())
    }

    override suspend fun getDatabaseInfo(dbName: DatabaseName): CouchDatabaseInfo {
        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.GET,
            path = HttpRequestPath("/${dbName.value}"),
            headers = headers
        ).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { CouchDatabaseInfo.fromJson(it) }
    }

    override suspend fun createDatabase(dbName: DatabaseName): CouchResponse {
        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.PUT,
            path = HttpRequestPath("/${dbName.value}"),
            headers = headers
        ).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { CouchResponse.fromJson(it) }
    }

    override suspend fun deleteDatabase(dbName: DatabaseName): CouchResponse {
        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.DELETE,
            path = HttpRequestPath("/${dbName.value}"),
            headers = headers
        ).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { CouchResponse.fromJson(it) }
    }

    override suspend fun getDocument(dbName: DatabaseName, docId: DocumentId, rev: RevisionId?): CouchDocument {
        val path = "/${dbName.value}/${docId.value}" + if (rev != null) "?rev=${rev.value}" else ""
        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.GET,
            path = HttpRequestPath(path),
            headers = headers
        ).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { CouchDocumentAdapter.fromJson(it) }
    }

    override suspend fun createDocument(dbName: DatabaseName, doc: CouchDocument, docId: DocumentId?): CouchResponse {
        val method = if (docId != null) HttpMethod.PUT else HttpMethod.POST
        val path = if (docId != null) "/${dbName.value}/${docId.value}" else "/${dbName.value}"

        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = method,
            path = HttpRequestPath(path),
            headers = headers,
            body = CouchDocumentAdapter.toJson(doc)
        ).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { CouchResponse.fromJson(it) }
    }

    override suspend fun updateDocument(dbName: DatabaseName, doc: CouchDocument): CouchResponse {
        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.PUT,
            path = HttpRequestPath("/${dbName.value}/${doc._id.value}"),
            headers = headers,
            body = CouchDocumentAdapter.toJson(doc)
        ).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { CouchResponse.fromJson(it) }
    }

    override suspend fun deleteDocument(dbName: DatabaseName, docId: DocumentId, rev: RevisionId): CouchResponse {
        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.DELETE,
            path = HttpRequestPath("/${dbName.value}/${docId.value}?rev=${rev.value}"),
            headers = headers
        ).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { CouchResponse.fromJson(it) }
    }

    override suspend fun copyDocument(dbName: DatabaseName, fromId: DocumentId, toId: DocumentId, toRev: RevisionId?): CouchResponse {
        val destination = toId.value + if (toRev != null) "?rev=${toRev.value}" else ""
        val copyHeaders = headers + (HttpHeaderName("Destination") to HttpHeaderValue(destination))
        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.COPY,
            path = HttpRequestPath("/${dbName.value}/${fromId.value}"),
            headers = copyHeaders
        ).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { CouchResponse.fromJson(it) }
    }

    override suspend fun bulkDocs(dbName: DatabaseName, docs: Series<CouchDocument>, allOrNothing: Boolean): Series<CouchResponse> {
        val body = JsonImpl.stringify(mapOf(
            "docs" to docs.play.map { JsonImpl.parse(CouchDocumentAdapter.toJson(it)) },
            "all_or_nothing" to allOrNothing
        ))
        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.POST,
            path = HttpRequestPath("/${dbName.value}/_bulk_docs"),
            headers = headers,
            body = body
        ).send()
        return handleResponse(response) {
            val list = JsonImpl.parse(it) as List<Map<String, Any?>>
            list.map { item ->
                CouchResponse(
                    ok = item["ok"] as? Boolean ?: (item["error"] == null),
                    id = (item["id"] as? String)?.let { idVal -> DocumentId(idVal) },
                    rev = (item["rev"] as? String)?.let { revVal -> RevisionId(revVal) },
                    error = item["error"] as? String,
                    reason = item["reason"] as? String
                )
            }.toSeries()
        }
    }

    override suspend fun getDesignDocument(dbName: DatabaseName, docId: DocumentId): CouchDesignDocument {
        val response = getDocument(dbName, docId)
        return CouchDesignDocumentAdapter.fromJson(CouchDocumentAdapter.toJson(response))
    }

    override suspend fun saveDesignDocument(dbName: DatabaseName, doc: CouchDesignDocument): CouchResponse {
        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.PUT,
            path = HttpRequestPath("/${dbName.value}/${doc.id.asDocId().value}"),
            headers = headers,
            body = CouchDesignDocumentAdapter.toJson(doc)
        ).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { CouchResponse.fromJson(it) }
    }

    override suspend fun <K, V> queryView(dbName: DatabaseName, designDocId: DocumentId, viewName: ViewName, params: ViewQueryParams): ViewResponse<K, V> {
        val path = "/${dbName.value}/_design/${designDocId.value}/_view/${viewName.value}${params.toQueryString()}"
        val response = HttpRequest(method = HttpMethod.GET, path = HttpRequestPath(path), headers = headers).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { ViewResponseAdapter.fromJson(it) }
    }

    override suspend fun getSecurity(dbName: DatabaseName): CouchSecurity {
        val response = HttpRequest(method = HttpMethod.GET, path = HttpRequestPath("/${dbName.value}/_security"), headers = headers).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { CouchSecurity.fromJson(it) }
    }

    override suspend fun setSecurity(dbName: DatabaseName, security: CouchSecurity): CouchResponse {
        val response = HttpRequest(method = HttpMethod.PUT, path = HttpRequestPath("/${dbName.value}/_security"), headers = headers, body = security.toJson()).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { CouchResponse.fromJson(it) }
    }
}

import org.flatton.types.*
import borg.trikeshed.lib.*
import borg.trikeshed.net.http.*
import borg.trikeshed.parse.json.*

class WasmCouchClient(
    private val baseUrl: String = "http://127.0.0.1:5984" // Default to localhost
) : CouchClient {
    private val headers = mapOf(
        HttpHeaderName("Content-Type") to HttpHeaderValue("application/json"),
        HttpHeaderName("Accept") to HttpHeaderValue("application/json")
    )

    private suspend fun <T> handleResponse(response: HttpResponse, onSuccess: (String) -> T): T {
        if (!response.isSuccess) {
            val errorBody = response.body.toString()
            val error = try { CouchError.fromJson(errorBody) } catch (e: Exception) { null }
            throw CouchException("CouchDB request failed with status ${response.status.value}", error?.error, error?.reason)
        }
        return onSuccess(response.body.toString())
    }

    override suspend fun getDatabaseInfo(dbName: DatabaseName): CouchDatabaseInfo {
        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.GET,
            path = HttpRequestPath("/${dbName.value}"),
            headers = headers
        ).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { CouchDatabaseInfo.fromJson(it) }
    }

    override suspend fun createDatabase(dbName: DatabaseName): CouchResponse {
        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.PUT,
            path = HttpRequestPath("/${dbName.value}"),
            headers = headers
        ).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { CouchResponse.fromJson(it) }
    }

    override suspend fun deleteDatabase(dbName: DatabaseName): CouchResponse {
        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.DELETE,
            path = HttpRequestPath("/${dbName.value}"),
            headers = headers
        ).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { CouchResponse.fromJson(it) }
    }

    override suspend fun getDocument(dbName: DatabaseName, docId: DocumentId, rev: RevisionId?): CouchDocument {
        val path = "/${dbName.value}/${docId.value}" + if (rev != null) "?rev=${rev.value}" else ""
        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.GET,
            path = HttpRequestPath(path),
            headers = headers
        ).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { CouchDocumentAdapter.fromJson(it) }
    }

    override suspend fun createDocument(dbName: DatabaseName, doc: CouchDocument, docId: DocumentId?): CouchResponse {
        val method = if (docId != null) HttpMethod.PUT else HttpMethod.POST
        val path = if (docId != null) "/${dbName.value}/${docId.value}" else "/${dbName.value}"

        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = method,
            path = HttpRequestPath(path),
            headers = headers,
            body = CouchDocumentAdapter.toJson(doc)
        ).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { CouchResponse.fromJson(it) }
    }

    override suspend fun updateDocument(dbName: DatabaseName, doc: CouchDocument): CouchResponse {
        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.PUT,
            path = HttpRequestPath("/${dbName.value}/${doc._id.value}"),
            headers = headers,
            body = CouchDocumentAdapter.toJson(doc)
        ).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { CouchResponse.fromJson(it) }
    }

    override suspend fun deleteDocument(dbName: DatabaseName, docId: DocumentId, rev: RevisionId): CouchResponse {
        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.DELETE,
            path = HttpRequestPath("/${dbName.value}/${docId.value}?rev=${rev.value}"),
            headers = headers
        ).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { CouchResponse.fromJson(it) }
    }

    override suspend fun copyDocument(dbName: DatabaseName, fromId: DocumentId, toId: DocumentId, toRev: RevisionId?): CouchResponse {
        val destination = toId.value + if (toRev != null) "?rev=${toRev.value}" else ""
        val copyHeaders = headers + (HttpHeaderName("Destination") to HttpHeaderValue(destination))
        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.COPY,
            path = HttpRequestPath("/${dbName.value}/${fromId.value}"),
            headers = copyHeaders
        ).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { CouchResponse.fromJson(it) }
    }

    override suspend fun bulkDocs(dbName: DatabaseName, docs: Series<CouchDocument>, allOrNothing: Boolean): Series<CouchResponse> {
        val body = JsonImpl.stringify(mapOf(
            "docs" to docs.play.map { JsonImpl.parse(CouchDocumentAdapter.toJson(it)) },
            "all_or_nothing" to allOrNothing
        ))
        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.POST,
            path = HttpRequestPath("/${dbName.value}/_bulk_docs"),
            headers = headers,
            body = body
        ).send()
        return handleResponse(response) {
            val list = JsonImpl.parse(it) as List<Map<String, Any?>>
            list.map { item ->
                CouchResponse(
                    ok = item["ok"] as? Boolean ?: (item["error"] == null),
                    id = (item["id"] as? String)?.let { idVal -> DocumentId(idVal) },
                    rev = (item["rev"] as? String)?.let { revVal -> RevisionId(revVal) },
                    error = item["error"] as? String,
                    reason = item["reason"] as? String
                )
            }.toSeries()
        }
    }

    override suspend fun getDesignDocument(dbName: DatabaseName, docId: DocumentId): CouchDesignDocument {
        val response = getDocument(dbName, docId)
        return CouchDesignDocumentAdapter.fromJson(CouchDocumentAdapter.toJson(response))
    }

    override suspend fun saveDesignDocument(dbName: DatabaseName, doc: CouchDesignDocument): CouchResponse {
        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.PUT,
            path = HttpRequestPath("/${dbName.value}/${doc.id.asDocId().value}"),
            headers = headers,
            body = CouchDesignDocumentAdapter.toJson(doc)
        ).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { CouchResponse.fromJson(it) }
    }

    override suspend fun <K, V> queryView(dbName: DatabaseName, designDocId: DocumentId, viewName: ViewName, params: ViewQueryParams): ViewResponse<K, V> {
        val path = "/${dbName.value}/_design/${designDocId.value}/_view/${viewName.value}${params.toQueryString()}"
        val response = HttpRequest(method = HttpMethod.GET, path = HttpRequestPath(path), headers = headers).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { ViewResponseAdapter.fromJson(it) }
    }

    override suspend fun getSecurity(dbName: DatabaseName): CouchSecurity {
        val response = HttpRequest(method = HttpMethod.GET, path = HttpRequestPath("/${dbName.value}/_security"), headers = headers).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { CouchSecurity.fromJson(it) }
    }

    override suspend fun updateSecurity(dbName: DatabaseName, security: CouchSecurity): CouchResponse {
        val response = HttpRequest(method = HttpMethod.PUT, path = HttpRequestPath("/${dbName.value}/_security"), headers = headers, body = security.toJson()).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { CouchResponse.fromJson(it) }
    }

    override suspend fun enableAdminParty(config: AdminPartyConfig): CouchResponse {
        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.PUT,
            path = HttpRequestPath("/_node/_local/_config/admins"),
            headers = headers,
            body = config.toJson()
        ).send()

        if (!response.isSuccess) throw CouchException("Failed to enable admin party")
        return CouchResponse.fromJson(response.body.toString())
    }

    override suspend fun disableAdminParty(): CouchResponse {
        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.DELETE,
            path = HttpRequestPath("/_node/_local/_config/admins"),
            headers = headers
        ).send()

        if (!response.isSuccess) throw CouchException("Failed to disable admin party")
        return CouchResponse.fromJson(response.body.toString())
    }

    override suspend fun getAdminPartyConfig(): AdminPartyConfig {
        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.GET,
            path = HttpRequestPath("/_node/_local/_config/admins"),
            headers = headers
        ).send()

        if (!response.isSuccess) throw CouchException("Failed to get admin party config")
        return AdminPartyConfig.fromJson(response.body.toString())
    }
}

import org.flatton.types.*
import borg.trikeshed.lib.*
import borg.trikeshed.net.http.*
import borg.trikeshed.parse.json.*

class WasmCouchClient(
    private val baseUrl: String = "http://127.0.0.1:5984" // Default to localhost
) : CouchClient {
    private val headers = mapOf(
        HttpHeaderName("Content-Type") to HttpHeaderValue("application/json"),
        HttpHeaderName("Accept") to HttpHeaderValue("application/json")
    )

    private suspend fun <T> handleResponse(response: HttpResponse, onSuccess: (String) -> T): T {
        if (!response.isSuccess) {
            val errorBody = response.body.toString()
            val error = try { CouchError.fromJson(errorBody) } catch (e: Exception) { null }
            throw CouchException("CouchDB request failed with status ${response.status.value}", error?.error, error?.reason)
        }
        return onSuccess(response.body.toString())
    }

    override suspend fun getDatabaseInfo(dbName: DatabaseName): CouchDatabaseInfo {
        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.GET,
            path = HttpRequestPath("/${dbName.value}"),
            headers = headers
        ).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { CouchDatabaseInfo.fromJson(it) }
    }

    override suspend fun createDatabase(dbName: DatabaseName): CouchResponse {
        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.PUT,
            path = HttpRequestPath("/${dbName.value}"),
            headers = headers
        ).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { CouchResponse.fromJson(it) }
    }

    override suspend fun deleteDatabase(dbName: DatabaseName): CouchResponse {
        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.DELETE,
            path = HttpRequestPath("/${dbName.value}"),
            headers = headers
        ).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { CouchResponse.fromJson(it) }
    }

    override suspend fun getDocument(dbName: DatabaseName, docId: DocumentId, rev: RevisionId?): CouchDocument {
        val path = "/${dbName.value}/${docId.value}" + if (rev != null) "?rev=${rev.value}" else ""
        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.GET,
            path = HttpRequestPath(path),
            headers = headers
        ).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { CouchDocumentAdapter.fromJson(it) }
    }

    override suspend fun createDocument(dbName: DatabaseName, doc: CouchDocument, docId: DocumentId?): CouchResponse {
        val method = if (docId != null) HttpMethod.PUT else HttpMethod.POST
        val path = if (docId != null) "/${dbName.value}/${docId.value}" else "/${dbName.value}"

        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = method,
            path = HttpRequestPath(path),
            headers = headers,
            body = CouchDocumentAdapter.toJson(doc)
        ).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { CouchResponse.fromJson(it) }
    }

    override suspend fun updateDocument(dbName: DatabaseName, doc: CouchDocument): CouchResponse {
        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.PUT,
            path = HttpRequestPath("/${dbName.value}/${doc._id.value}"),
            headers = headers,
            body = CouchDocumentAdapter.toJson(doc)
        ).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { CouchResponse.fromJson(it) }
    }

    override suspend fun deleteDocument(dbName: DatabaseName, docId: DocumentId, rev: RevisionId): CouchResponse {
        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.DELETE,
            path = HttpRequestPath("/${dbName.value}/${docId.value}?rev=${rev.value}"),
            headers = headers
        ).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { CouchResponse.fromJson(it) }
    }

    override suspend fun copyDocument(dbName: DatabaseName, fromId: DocumentId, toId: DocumentId, toRev: RevisionId?): CouchResponse {
        val destination = toId.value + if (toRev != null) "?rev=${toRev.value}" else ""
        val copyHeaders = headers + (HttpHeaderName("Destination") to HttpHeaderValue(destination))
        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.COPY,
            path = HttpRequestPath("/${dbName.value}/${fromId.value}"),
            headers = copyHeaders
        ).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { CouchResponse.fromJson(it) }
    }

    override suspend fun bulkDocs(dbName: DatabaseName, docs: Series<CouchDocument>, allOrNothing: Boolean): Series<CouchResponse> {
        val body = JsonImpl.stringify(mapOf(
            "docs" to docs.play.map { JsonImpl.parse(CouchDocumentAdapter.toJson(it)) },
            "all_or_nothing" to allOrNothing
        ))
        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.POST,
            path = HttpRequestPath("/${dbName.value}/_bulk_docs"),
            headers = headers,
            body = body
        ).send()
        return handleResponse(response) {
            val list = JsonImpl.parse(it) as List<Map<String, Any?>>
            list.map { item ->
                CouchResponse(
                    ok = item["ok"] as? Boolean ?: (item["error"] == null),
                    id = (item["id"] as? String)?.let { idVal -> DocumentId(idVal) },
                    rev = (item["rev"] as? String)?.let { revVal -> RevisionId(revVal) },
                    error = item["error"] as? String,
                    reason = item["reason"] as? String
                )
            }.toSeries()
        }
    }

    override suspend fun getDesignDocument(dbName: DatabaseName, docId: DocumentId): CouchDesignDocument {
        val response = getDocument(dbName, docId)
        return CouchDesignDocumentAdapter.fromJson(CouchDocumentAdapter.toJson(response))
    }

    override suspend fun saveDesignDocument(dbName: DatabaseName, doc: CouchDesignDocument): CouchResponse {
        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.PUT,
            path = HttpRequestPath("/${dbName.value}/${doc.id.asDocId().value}"),
            headers = headers,
            body = CouchDesignDocumentAdapter.toJson(doc)
        ).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { CouchResponse.fromJson(it) }
    }

    override suspend fun <K, V> queryView(dbName: DatabaseName, designDocId: DocumentId, viewName: ViewName, params: ViewQueryParams): ViewResponse<K, V> {
        val path = "/${dbName.value}/_design/${designDocId.value}/_view/${viewName.value}${params.toQueryString()}"
        val response = HttpRequest(method = HttpMethod.GET, path = HttpRequestPath(path), headers = headers).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { ViewResponseAdapter.fromJson(it) }
    }

    override suspend fun getSecurity(dbName: DatabaseName): CouchSecurity {
        val response = HttpRequest(method = HttpMethod.GET, path = HttpRequestPath("/${dbName.value}/_security"), headers = headers).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { CouchSecurity.fromJson(it) }
    }

    override suspend fun updateSecurity(dbName: DatabaseName, security: CouchSecurity): CouchResponse {
        val response = HttpRequest(method = HttpMethod.PUT, path = HttpRequestPath("/${dbName.value}/_security"), headers = headers, body = security.toJson()).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { CouchResponse.fromJson(it) }
    }

    override suspend fun enableAdminParty(config: AdminPartyConfig): CouchResponse {
        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.PUT,
            path = HttpRequestPath("/_node/_local/_config/admins"),
            headers = headers,
            body = config.toJson()
        ).send()

        if (!response.isSuccess) throw CouchException("Failed to enable admin party")
        return CouchResponse.fromJson(response.body.toString())
    }

    override suspend fun disableAdminParty(): CouchResponse {
        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.DELETE,
            path = HttpRequestPath("/_node/_local/_config/admins"),
            headers = headers
        ).send()

        if (!response.isSuccess) throw CouchException("Failed to disable admin party")
        return CouchResponse.fromJson(response.body.toString())
    }

    override suspend fun getAdminPartyConfig(): AdminPartyConfig {
        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.GET,
            path = HttpRequestPath("/_node/_local/_config/admins"),
            headers = headers
        ).send()

        if (!response.isSuccess) throw CouchException("Failed to get admin party config")
        return AdminPartyConfig.fromJson(response.body.toString())
    }
}

import org.flatton.types.*
import borg.trikeshed.lib.*
import borg.trikeshed.net.http.*
import borg.trikeshed.parse.json.*

class WasmCouchClient(
    private val baseUrl: String = "http://127.0.0.1:5984"
) : CouchClient {
    private val headers = mapOf(
        HttpHeaderName("Content-Type") to HttpHeaderValue("application/json"),
        HttpHeaderName("Accept") to HttpHeaderValue("application/json")
    )

    private suspend fun <T> handleResponse(response: HttpResponse, onSuccess: (String) -> T): T {
        if (!response.isSuccess) {
            val errorBody = response.body.toString()
            val error = try { CouchError.fromJson(errorBody) } catch (e: Exception) { null }
            throw CouchException("CouchDB request failed with status ${response.status.value}", error?.error, error?.reason)
        }
        return onSuccess(response.body.toString())
    }

    override suspend fun getDatabaseInfo(dbName: DatabaseName): CouchDatabaseInfo {
        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.GET,
            path = HttpRequestPath("/${dbName.value}"),
            headers = headers
        ).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { CouchDatabaseInfo.fromJson(it) }
    }

    override suspend fun createDatabase(dbName: DatabaseName): CouchResponse {
        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.PUT,
            path = HttpRequestPath("/${dbName.value}"),
            headers = headers
        ).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { CouchResponse.fromJson(it) }
    }

    override suspend fun deleteDatabase(dbName: DatabaseName): CouchResponse {
        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.DELETE,
            path = HttpRequestPath("/${dbName.value}"),
            headers = headers
        ).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { CouchResponse.fromJson(it) }
    }

    override suspend fun getDocument(dbName: DatabaseName, docId: DocumentId, rev: RevisionId?): CouchDocument {
        val path = "/${dbName.value}/${docId.value}" + if (rev != null) "?rev=${rev.value}" else ""
        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.GET,
            path = HttpRequestPath(path),
            headers = headers
        ).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { CouchDocumentAdapter.fromJson(it) }
    }

    override suspend fun createDocument(dbName: DatabaseName, doc: CouchDocument, docId: DocumentId?): CouchResponse {
        val method = if (docId != null) HttpMethod.PUT else HttpMethod.POST
        val path = if (docId != null) "/${dbName.value}/${docId.value}" else "/${dbName.value}"

        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = method,
            path = HttpRequestPath(path),
            headers = headers,
            body = CouchDocumentAdapter.toJson(doc)
        ).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { CouchResponse.fromJson(it) }
    }

    override suspend fun updateDocument(dbName: DatabaseName, doc: CouchDocument): CouchResponse {
        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.PUT,
            path = HttpRequestPath("/${dbName.value}/${doc._id.value}"),
            headers = headers,
            body = CouchDocumentAdapter.toJson(doc)
        ).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { CouchResponse.fromJson(it) }
    }

    override suspend fun deleteDocument(dbName: DatabaseName, docId: DocumentId, rev: RevisionId): CouchResponse {
        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.DELETE,
            path = HttpRequestPath("/${dbName.value}/${docId.value}?rev=${rev.value}"),
            headers = headers
        ).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { CouchResponse.fromJson(it) }
    }

    override suspend fun copyDocument(dbName: DatabaseName, fromId: DocumentId, toId: DocumentId, toRev: RevisionId?): CouchResponse {
        val destination = toId.value + if (toRev != null) "?rev=${toRev.value}" else ""
        val copyHeaders = headers + (HttpHeaderName("Destination") to HttpHeaderValue(destination))
        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.COPY,
            path = HttpRequestPath("/${dbName.value}/${fromId.value}"),
            headers = copyHeaders
        ).send()
        return handleResponse(response) { CouchResponse.fromJson(it) }
    }

    override suspend fun bulkDocs(dbName: DatabaseName, docs: Series<CouchDocument>, allOrNothing: Boolean): Series<CouchResponse> {
        val body = JsonImpl.stringify(mapOf(
            "docs" to docs.play.map { JsonImpl.parse(CouchDocumentAdapter.toJson(it)) },
            "all_or_nothing" to allOrNothing
        ))
        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.POST,
            path = HttpRequestPath("/${dbName.value}/_bulk_docs"),
            headers = headers,
            body = body
        ).send()
        return handleResponse(response) {
            val list = JsonImpl.parse(it) as List<Map<String, Any?>>
            list.map { item ->
                CouchResponse(
                    ok = item["ok"] as? Boolean ?: (item["error"] == null),
                    id = (item["id"] as? String)?.let { idVal -> DocumentId(idVal) },
                    rev = (item["rev"] as? String)?.let { revVal -> RevisionId(revVal) },
                    error = item["error"] as? String,
                    reason = item["reason"] as?

package org.flatton.client

import org.flatton.types.*
import borg.trikeshed.lib.*
import borg.trikeshed.net.http.*
import borg.trikeshed.parse.json.*

class WasmCouchClient(
    private val baseUrl: String = "http://localhost:5984"
) : CouchClient {
    private val headers = mapOf(
        HttpHeaderName("Content-Type") to HttpHeaderValue("application/json"),
        HttpHeaderName("Accept") to HttpHeaderValue("application/json")
    )

    private suspend fun <T> executeRequest(
        method: HttpMethod,
        path: String,
        body: String? = null,
        additionalHeaders: Map<HttpHeaderName, HttpHeaderValue> = emptyMap(),
        parser: (String) -> T
    ): T {
        val requestHeaders = headers + additionalHeaders
        val response = HttpRequest(
            method = method,
            path = HttpRequestPath(path),
            headers = requestHeaders,
            body = body
        ).send()

        if (!response.isSuccess) {
            throw CouchException("Request failed with status ${response.status}")
        }
        
        return parser(response.body.toString())
    }

    override suspend fun getDatabaseInfo(dbName: DatabaseName): CouchDatabaseInfo {
        return executeRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.GET,
            path = "/${dbName.value}",
            parser = CouchDatabaseInfo::fromJson
        )
    }

    override suspend fun createDatabase(dbName: DatabaseName): CouchResponse {
        return executeRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.PUT,
            path = "/${dbName.value}",
            parser = CouchResponse::fromJson
        )

package borg.trikeshed.net.http

import borg.trikeshed.lib.toByteArray
import borg.trikeshed.net.http.HttpServer.ConnectionState.*
import borg.trikeshed.net.http.HttpServer.ConnectionState.Companion.invoke
import borg.trikeshed.reactor.*
import borg.trikeshed.lib.toSeries

val Series<Char>.toRequest: HttpRequest
    get() = TODO()

class HttpServer(
    private val port: Int,
    private val handler: (HttpRequest) -> HttpResponse = { _ -> HttpResponse(200, "OK") }
) : UnaryAsyncReaction {
    private val serverChannel = ServerChannel()

    init {
        serverChannel.bind(port)
    }

    override fun onAccept(key: SelectionKey): AsyncReaction? {
        val clientChannel = key.channel.accept()
        return OP_ACCEPT()
    }

    override fun onRead(key: SelectionKey): AsyncReaction? {
        val buffer = ByteArray(1024)
        val read = key.channel.read(buffer.toSeries())
        return if (read > 0) {
            val request = parseRequest(buffer.sliceArray(0 until read))
            val response = handler(request)
            key.channel.write(response.toByteArray())
            OP_READ()
        } else {
            null
        }
    }

    private fun parseRequest(bytes: ByteArray): HttpRequest {
        val requestLine = bytes.toSeries().asString()
        return HttpRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.GET,
            path = HttpRequestPath("/"),
            headers = emptyMap(),
            body = bytes.toSeries()
        )
    }
}

package borg.trikeshed.net.quic

import borg.trikeshed.platform.AppDispatchers
import borg.trikeshed.platform.ByteBuffer
import borg.trikeshed.platform.DatagramPacket
import borg.trikeshed.platform.DatagramSocket
import borg.trikeshed.platform.InetSocketAddress
import borg.trikeshed.platform.SocketException
import kotlinx.coroutines.channels.Channel
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.receiveAsFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.Job
import kotlinx.coroutines.SupervisorJob
import kotlinx.coroutines.isActive
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import java.net.SocketException

enum class FrameType {
    PADDING, PING, ACK, STREAM, CONNECTION_CLOSE
}

data class StreamFrame(
    val streamId: Long,
    val offset: Long,
    val length: Int,
    val fin: Boolean,
    val data: ByteArray
) {
    override fun equals(other: Any?): Boolean {
        if (this === other) return true
        if (javaClass != other?.javaClass) return false

        other as StreamFrame

        if (streamId != other.streamId) return false
        if (offset != other.offset) return false
        if (length != other.length) return false
        if (fin != other.fin) return false
        if (!data.contentEquals(other.data)) return false

        return true
    }

    override fun hashCode(): Int {
        var result = streamId.hashCode()
        result = 31 * result + offset.hashCode()
        result = 31 * result + length
        result = 31 * result + fin.hashCode()
        result = 31 * result + data.contentHashCode()
        return result
    }
}

enum class QuicPacketType {
    INITIAL, ZERO_RTT, HANDSHAKE, SHORT_HEADER
}

data class QuicPacketHeader(
    val type: QuicPacketType,
    val destinationConnectionId: ByteArray,
    val sourceConnectionId: ByteArray,
    val packetNumber: Long,
    val version: Int = 0x00000001,
    val token: ByteArray? = null
) {
    override fun equals(other: Any?): Boolean {
        if (this === other) return true
        if (javaClass != other?.javaClass) return false

        other as QuicPacketHeader

        if (type != other.type) return false
        if (!destinationConnectionId.contentEquals(other.destinationConnectionId)) return false
        if (!sourceConnectionId.contentEquals(other.sourceConnectionId)) return false
        if (packetNumber != other.packetNumber) return false
        if (version != other.version) return false
        if (token != null) {
            if (other.token == null) return false
            if (!token.contentEquals(other.token)) return false
        } else if (other.token != null) return false

        return true
    }

    override fun hashCode(): Int {
        var result = type.hashCode()
        result = 31 * result + destinationConnectionId.contentHashCode()
        result = 31 * result + sourceConnectionId.contentHashCode()
        result = 31 * result + packetNumber.hashCode()
        result = 31 * result + version
        result = 31 * result + (token?.contentHashCode() ?: 0)
        return result
    }
}

data class QuicPacket(
    val header: QuicPacketHeader,
    val frames: List<Any>
)

class EnhancedQuicConnection(
    private val config: QuicConfig,
    private val sessionCache: QuicSessionCache
) : AutoCloseable {
    companion object {
        const val MAX_STREAMS = 1L shl 62
        const val DEFAULT_STREAM_BUFFER_SIZE = 64 * 1024
    }

    private var socket: DatagramSocket? = null
    private val activeStreams = mutableMapOf<Long, QuicStream>()
    private val streamBufferSize = config.streamBufferSize ?: DEFAULT_STREAM_BUFFER_SIZE
    private var nextClientStreamId = 0L

    private var localConnectionId: ByteArray = ByteArray(8)
    private var remoteConnectionId: ByteArray = ByteArray(0)
    private var nextPacketNumber: Long = 0L
    private var receivingJob: Job? = null

    fun connectWith0RTT(serverAddress: String, port: Int): Boolean {
        val cachedSession = sessionCache.getSession(serverAddress, port)
        if (cachedSession != null && config.enable0RTT) {
            try {
                socket = establish0RTTConnection(serverAddress, port, cachedSession)
                return true
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                sessionCache.clearSession(serverAddress, port)
                socket = establishRegularConnection(serverAddress, port)
                return true
            }
        } else {
            socket = establishRegularConnection(serverAddress, port)
            return true
        }
    }

    private fun establish0RTTConnection(
        serverAddress: String,
        port: Int,
        sessionData: QuicSessionData
    ): DatagramSocket {
        val socket = DatagramSocket()
        val serverAddr = InetSocketAddress(serverAddress, port)
        socket.connect(serverAddr)

        val initialPacket = create0RTTPacket(sessionData)
        socket.send(DatagramPacket(initialPacket, initialPacket.size, serverAddr))

        val responseBuffer = ByteArray(streamBufferSize)
        val responsePacket = DatagramPacket(responseBuffer, responseBuffer.size)
        socket.receive(responsePacket)

        this.remoteConnectionId = ByteArray(8)
        startReceivingLoop()
        return socket
    }

    private fun establishRegularConnection(
        serverAddress: String,
        port: Int
    ): DatagramSocket {
        val socket = DatagramSocket()
        val serverAddr = InetSocketAddress(serverAddress, port)
        socket.connect(serverAddr)

        val initialPacket = createInitialPacket()
        socket.send(DatagramPacket(initialPacket, initialPacket.size, serverAddr))

        val responseBuffer = ByteArray(streamBufferSize)
        val responsePacket = DatagramPacket(responseBuffer, responseBuffer.size)
        socket.receive(responsePacket)

        this.remoteConnectionId = ByteArray(8)
        startReceivingLoop()
        return socket
    }

    private fun startReceivingLoop() {
        if (receivingJob?.isActive == true) return
        val currentSocket = socket ?: return

        receivingJob = CoroutineScope(AppDispatchers.IO + SupervisorJob()).launch {
            val receiveBuffer = ByteArray(streamBufferSize)
            val datagramPacket = DatagramPacket(receiveBuffer, receiveBuffer.size)
            try {
                while (currentSocket.isConnected && isActive) {
                    try {
                        currentSocket.receive(datagramPacket)
                        val packet = deserializePacket(datagramPacket.data, datagramPacket.length)
                        if (packet != null) {
                            for (frame in packet.frames) {
                                when (frame) {
                                    is StreamFrame -> {
                                        val stream = activeStreams[frame.streamId]
                                        if (stream != null) {
                                            stream.deliverData(frame.data)
                                            if (frame.fin) {
                                                stream.onRemoteFin()
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    } catch (se: SocketException) {
                        if (!isActive || currentSocket.isClosed) break
                    }
                }
            } finally {
                println("QUIC Receiving loop stopped.")
            }
        }
    }

    private fun deserializePacket(bytes: ByteArray, length: Int): QuicPacket? {
        val buffer = ByteBuffer.wrap(bytes, 0, length)
        try {
            val packetTypeOrdinal = buffer.get().toInt()
            val packetType = QuicPacketType.values().getOrNull(packetTypeOrdinal) ?: return null

            val destCid = ByteArray(8)
            buffer.get(destCid)
            val srcCid = ByteArray(8)
            buffer.get(srcCid)
            val packetNumber = buffer.getLong()

            val header = QuicPacketHeader(
                type = packetType,
                destinationConnectionId = destCid,
                sourceConnectionId = srcCid,
                packetNumber = packetNumber
            )

            val frames = mutableListOf<Any>()
            if (buffer.hasRemaining()) {
                val frameTypeOrdinal = buffer.get().toInt()
                val frameType = FrameType.values().getOrNull(frameTypeOrdinal)

                if (frameType == FrameType.STREAM) {
                    val streamId = buffer.getLong()
                    val offset = buffer.getLong()
                    val dataLength = buffer.getInt()
                    val fin = buffer.get() == 1.toByte()

                    val data = ByteArray(dataLength)
                    buffer.get(data)

                    frames.add(StreamFrame(streamId, offset, dataLength, fin, data))
                }
            }
            return QuicPacket(header, frames)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            return null
        }
    }

    private fun create0RTTPacket(sessionData: QuicSessionData): ByteArray {
        return byteArrayOf(0x01) + sessionData.sessionId + sessionData.ticket
    }

    private fun createInitialPacket(): ByteArray {
        return byteArrayOf(0x00) + Random.nextBytes(32)
    }
}

data class QuicConfig(
    val streamBufferSize: Int? = null,
    val maxConcurrentStreams: Long = EnhancedQuicConnection.MAX_STREAMS,
    val enable0RTT: Boolean = true
)

enum class QuicStreamState { IDLE, OPEN, LOCAL_CLOSED, REMOTE_CLOSED, CLOSED, RESET }

class QuicStream(
    val id: Long,
    private val connection: EnhancedQuicConnection,
    private val streamBufferSize: Int
) {
    private var sendOffset: Long = 0
    private val incomingDataChannel = Channel<ByteArray>(Channel.UNLIMITED)

    fun deliverData(data: ByteArray) {
        incomingDataChannel.trySend(data)
    }

    fun dataFlow(): Flow<ByteArray> = incomingDataChannel.receiveAsFlow()

    suspend fun close() {
        incomingDataChannel.close()
    }

    fun onRemoteFin() {
        incomingDataChannel.close()
    }
}

interface QuicSessionCache {
    fun getSession(serverAddress: String, port: Int): QuicSessionData?
    fun storeSession(serverAddress: String, port: Int, sessionData: QuicSessionData)
    fun clearSession(serverAddress: String, port: Int)
}

data class QuicSessionData(
    val serverAddress: String,
    val port: Int,
    val sessionId: ByteArray,
    val ticket: ByteArray,
    val expirationTime: Long
)

package borg.trikeshed.parse.json

import borg.trikeshed.lib.Join
import borg.trikeshed.lib.Series
import borg.trikeshed.lib.Twin
import borg.trikeshed.lib.collections.Either
import borg.trikeshed.lib.j
import borg.trikeshed.qol.d
import borg.trikeshed.qol.nz
import borg.trikeshed.qol.or
import borg.trikeshed.qol.tuple

typealias JsElement = Join<Twin<Int>, Series<Int>>
typealias JsIndex = Join<Twin<Int>, Series<Char>>
typealias JsContext = Join<JsElement, Series<Char>>

typealias JsPathElement = Either<String, Int>
typealias JsPath = Join<Int, (Int) -> JsPathElement>

fun JsIndex.toSeries(): Series<Char> = b.slice(a.a..a.b)

val List<*>.toJsPath: JsPath
    get() = size j {
        when (val e = this[it!!]) {
            is String -> e.left()
            is Int -> e.right()
            else -> throw Exception("invalid path element")
        }
    }

val JsContext.segments: Iterable<JsIndex>
    get() = TODO("Implement segments logic")

private val `s_` = " \t\r\n".toSeries()

object JsonParser {
    fun parse(json: Series<Char>): JsContext {
        val (element, _) = parseValue(json.trim())
        return element j json
    }

    fun reify(context: JsContext): Any? = TODO("Implement reify logic")

    private fun parseValue(json: Series<Char>): Pair<JsElement, Series<Char>> {
        return when (json[0]) {
            '{' -> parseObject(json)
            '[' -> parseArray(json)
            '"' -> parseString(json)
            else -> parsePrimitive(json)
        }
    }

    private fun parseObject(json: Series<Char>): Pair<JsElement, Series<Char>> {
        var i = 1
        val commas = mutableListOf<Int>()
        while (i < json.size() && json[i] != '}') {
            i = json.seek(i) { it !in `s_` }
            val (key, afterKey) = parseString(json.slice(i..json.size - 1))
            i += key.a.b + 1
            i = json.seek(i) { it !in `s_` }
            if (json[i] != ':') throw Exception("Expected ':'")
            i++
            i = json.seek(i) { it !in `s_` }
            val (value, afterValue) = parseValue(json.slice(i..json.size - 1))
            i += value.a.b + 1
            if (json[i] == ',') {
                commas.add(i)
                i++
            }
        }
        return (0 j i) j commas.toSeries() to json.slice(i + 1)
    }

    private fun parseArray(json: Series<Char>): Pair<JsElement, Series<Char>> {
        var i = 1
        val commas = mutableListOf<Int>()
        while (i < json.size() && json[i] != ']') {
            i = json.seek(i) { it !in `s_` }
            val (value, afterValue) = parseValue(json.slice(i..json.size - 1))
            i += value.a.b + 1
            if (json[i] == ',') {
                commas.add(i)
                i++
            }
        }
        return (0 j i) j commas.toSeries() to json.slice(i + 1)
    }

    private fun parsePrimitive(json: Series<Char>): Pair<JsElement, Series<Char>> {
        var i = 0
        while (i < json.size() && json[i] !in ",]} \t\r\n".toSeries()) {
            i++
        }
        return (0 j i - 1) j emptySeries<Int>() to json.slice(i)
    }

    private fun parseString(json: Series<Char>): Pair<JsElement, Series<Char>> {
        val (s, r) = json.readString() ?: throw Exception("Invalid string")
        return (0 j s.length + 2) j emptySeries<Int>() to r
    }

    private fun Series<Char>.readString(): Pair<JsElement, Series<Char>>? {
        if (this[0] != '"') return null
        var i = 1
        while (i < size && this[i] != '"') {
            if (this[i] == '\\') i++
            i++
        }
        if (i == size) return null
        return (0 j i + 1) j emptySeries<Int>() to seekTo(i + 1)
    }

    private fun Series<Char>.seek(from: Int, predicate: (Char) -> Boolean): Int = TODO()
}

fun <T> emptySeries(): Series<T> = 0 j { throw IndexOutOfBoundsException() }

fun JsContext.query(path: JsPath): JsContext? = TODO()

fun Series<Char>.size(): Int = this.a

private operator fun Series<Char>.contains(c: Char): Boolean {
    for (i in 0 until a) {
        if (b(i) == c) return true
    }
    return false

package borg.trikeshed.platform

import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineDispatcher
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import java.net.DatagramPacket as JvmDatagramPacket
import java.net.DatagramSocket as JvmDatagramSocket
import java.net.InetSocketAddress as JvmInetSocketAddress
import java.net.SocketException as JvmSocketException
import java.nio.ByteBuffer as JvmByteBuffer
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap as JvmConcurrentHashMap

actual typealias DatagramSocket = JvmDatagramSocket
actual typealias DatagramPacket = JvmDatagramPacket
actual typealias InetSocketAddress = JvmInetSocketAddress
actual typealias SocketException = JvmSocketException

actual typealias Volatile = kotlin.jvm.Volatile
actual typealias ConcurrentHashMap<K, V> = JvmConcurrentHashMap<K, V>

actual object AppDispatchers {
    actual val IO: CoroutineDispatcher = Dispatchers.IO
}

actual fun <T> runBlocking(block: suspend kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope.() -> T): T = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking(Dispatchers.IO, block)

actual class ByteBuffer(private val jvmBuffer: JvmByteBuffer) {
    actual fun remaining(): Int = jvmBuffer.remaining()
    actual fun getLong(): Long = jvmBuffer.long
    actual fun get(dst: ByteArray) = jvmBuffer.get(dst)

    actual companion object {
        actual fun wrap(array: ByteArray): ByteBuffer = ByteBuffer(JvmByteBuffer.wrap(array))
    }
}

package borg.trikeshed.lib

typealias Series<T> = Join<Int, (Int) -> T>

val <T> Series<T>.size: Int get() = a
operator fun <T> Series<T>.get(index: Int): T = b(index)

fun Series<Byte>.toByteArray(): ByteArray {
    return ByteArray(size) { i -> this[i] }
}

fun ByteArray.toSeries(): Series<Byte> = size j { this[it] }

package borg.trikeshed.taxonomy

import kotlinx.serialization.*
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonElement
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonObject
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonPrimitive

class TaxonomicStorage(
    private val storage: StratifiedJsonStorage
) {
    private val json = Json { prettyPrint = true; isLenient = true }

    suspend fun addNode(node: TaxonomicNode) {
        val slab = JsonSlab(
            id = node.id,
            content = json.encodeToString(node).toByteArray(),
            metadata = mapOf(
                "taxonomyId" to "taxonomyId",
                "timestamp" to "0"
            )
        )
        storage.putSlab(slab)
    }

    suspend fun getNode(nodeId: String): TaxonomicNode? {
        val slab = storage.getSlab("nodes/$nodeId")
        return slab?.let { json.decodeFromString<TaxonomicNode>(it.content.toString()) }
    }
}

@Serializable
data class TaxonomicNode(
    val id: String,
    val title: String,
    val description: String,
    val parent: String?
)

**Trikeshed/src/commonMain/kotlin/borg/trikeshed/reactor/Reactor.kt**
```
package borg.trikeshed.reactor

import borg.trikeshed.platform.AppDispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.Job
import kotlinx.coroutines.channels.Channel
import borg.trikeshed.platform.SelectorInterface

class Reactor(
    private val selector: SelectorInterface,
    private val reactions: MutableMap<SelectableChannel, AsyncReaction> = mutableMapOf(),
    private val job: Job = Job(),
    private val scope: CoroutineScope = CoroutineScope(job + AppDispatchers.IO),
    private val bufferPool: BufferPool = BufferPoolImpl()
) {
    private val commandChannel = Channel<Command>(Channel.UNLIMITED)

    init {
        start()
    }

    private fun start() {
        scope.launch {
            while (job.isActive) {
                selector.select()
                val selectedKeys = selector.selectedKeys()
                for (key in selectedKeys) {
                    val reaction = reactions[key.channel]
                    if (reaction != null) {
                        val newReaction = when {
                            key.isReadable() -> reaction.onRead(key)
                            key.isWritable() -> reaction.onWrite(key)
                            key.isConnectable() -> reaction.onConnect(key)
                            key.isAcceptable() -> reaction.onAccept(key)
                            else -> null
                        }
                        if (newReaction != null) {
                            reactions[key.channel] = newReaction
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    internal class BufferPoolImpl : BufferPool {
        override fun acquire(size: Int): Series<Byte> = TODO("Not yet implemented")
        override fun release(buffer: Series<Byte>) = TODO("Not yet implemented")
    }
}

package borg.trikeshed.reactor.http

import borg.trikeshed.reactor.AsyncReaction
import borg.trikeshed.reactor.SelectionKey
import borg.trikeshed.reactor.UnaryAsyncReaction

class HttpMotdReaction(private val motd: String) : UnaryAsyncReaction {
    override fun onAccept(key: SelectionKey): AsyncReaction? {
        return OP_ACCEPT()
    }

    override fun onRead(key: SelectionKey): AsyncReaction? {
        val response = "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Length: ${motd.length}\r\n\r\n$motd"
        key.channel.write(response.toByteArray())
        return OP_READ()
    }
}

**Trikeshed/src/commonMain/kotlin/borg/trikeshed/reactor/http/HttpStateMachine.kt**
```
package borg.trikeshed.reactor.http

import borg.trikeshed.reactor.AsyncReaction
import borg.trikeshed.reactor.SelectionKey
import borg.trikeshed.reactor.UnaryAsyncReaction

class HttpStateMachine : UnaryAsyncReaction {
    override fun onRead(key: SelectionKey): AsyncReaction? {
        val buffer = ByteArray(1024)
        val read = key.channel.read(buffer.toSeries())
        return if (read > 0) {
            val request = parseRequest(buffer.sliceArray(0 until read))
            val response = handleRequest(request, key)
            OP_READ()
        } else {
            null
        }
    }

    private fun parseRequest(bytes: ByteArray): HttpRequest {
        val requestLine = bytes.toSeries().asString()
        return HttpRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.GET,
            path = HttpRequestPath("/"),
            headers = emptyMap(),
            body = bytes.toSeries()
        )
    }

    private fun handleRequest(request: HttpRequest, key: SelectionKey): AsyncReaction? {
        val response = "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Length: 12\r\n\r\nHello World!"
        key.channel.write(response.toByteArray())
        return null
    }
}
```

**Trikeshed/src/commonMain/kotlin/borg/trikeshed/reactor/HttpTypes.kt**
```
package borg.trikeshed.net.http

import borg.trikeshed.lib.Series

typealias HttpHeaders = Map<String, Series<Char>>

data class HttpRequest(
    val method: HttpMethod,
    val path: HttpRequestPath,
    val headers: HttpHeaders,
    val body: Series<Byte>
) {
    fun toHttpMessage(): Series<Byte> {
        val requestLine = "$method $path HTTP/1.1\r\n"
        val headersStr = headers.map { (k, v) -> "$k: ${v.play.joinToString("")}" }.joinToString("\r\n")
        val bodyBytes = body ?: ByteArray(0).toSeries()
        val head = "$requestLine$headersStr\r\n\r\n".toSeries().map { it.code.toByte() }.toSeries()
        return head + bodyBytes
    }
}

data class HttpResponse(
    val statusCode: Int,
    val reasonPhrase: String,
    val headers: HttpHeaders,
    val body: Series<Byte>
) {
    fun toHttpMessage(): Series<Byte> {
        val statusLine = "HTTP/1.1 $statusCode $reasonPhrase\r\n"
        val headersStr = headers.map { (k, v) -> "$k: ${v.play.joinToString("")}" }.joinToString("\r\n")
        val bodyBytes = body ?: ByteArray(0).toSeries()
        val head = "$statusLine$headersStr\r\n\r\n".toSeries().map { it.code.toByte() }.toSeries()
        return head + bodyBytes
    }
}
```

package borg.trikeshed.reactor

import borg.trikeshed.platform.AppDispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.Job
import kotlinx.coroutines.channels.Channel
import borg.trikeshed.platform.SelectorInterface

class Reactor(
    private val selector: SelectorInterface,
    private val reactions: MutableMap<SelectableChannel, AsyncReaction> = mutableMapOf(),
    private val job: Job = Job(),
    private val scope: CoroutineScope = CoroutineScope(job + AppDispatchers.IO),
    private val bufferPool: BufferPool = BufferPoolImpl()
) {
    private val commandChannel = Channel<Command>(Channel.UNLIMITED)

package borg.trikeshed.reactor.http

import borg.trikeshed.reactor.AsyncReaction
import borg.trikeshed.reactor.SelectionKey
import borg.trikeshed.reactor.UnaryAsyncReaction

class HttpServer(private val port: Int) : UnaryAsyncReaction {
    private val serverChannel = ServerChannel()

    init {
        serverChannel.bind(port)
    }

    override fun onAccept(key: SelectionKey): AsyncReaction? {
        val clientChannel = key.channel.accept()
        return OP_ACCEPT()
    }

    override fun onRead(key: SelectionKey): AsyncReaction? {
        val buffer = ByteArray(1024)
        val read = key.channel.read(buffer.toSeries())
        return if (read > 0) {
            val request = parseRequest(buffer.sliceArray(0 until read))
            val response = handleRequest(request, key)
            OP_READ()
        } else {
            null
        }
    }

    private fun parseRequest(bytes: ByteArray): HttpRequest {
        val requestLine = bytes.toSeries().asString()
        return HttpRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.GET,
            path = HttpRequestPath("/"),
            headers = emptyMap(),
            body = bytes.toSeries()
        )
    }

    private fun handleRequest(request: HttpRequest, key: SelectionKey): AsyncReaction? {
        val response = "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Length: 12\r\n\r\nHello World!"
        key.channel.write(response.toByteArray())
        return null
    }
}
```

package borg.trikeshed.net.http

import borg.trikeshed.lib.Series

typealias HttpHeaders = Map<String, Series<Char>>

data class HttpRequest(
    val method: HttpMethod,
    val path: HttpRequestPath,
    val headers: HttpHeaders,
    val body: Series<Byte>
) {
    fun toHttpMessage(): Series<Byte> {
        val requestLine = "$method $path HTTP/1.1\r\n"
        val headersStr = headers.map { (k, v) -> "$k: ${v.play.joinToString("")}" }.joinToString("\r\n")
        val bodyBytes = body ?: ByteArray(0).toSeries()
        val head = "$requestLine$headersStr\r\n\r\n".toSeries().map { it.code.toByte() }.toSeries()
        return head + bodyBytes
    }
}

data class HttpResponse(
    val statusCode: Int,
    val reasonPhrase: String,
    val headers: HttpHeaders,
    val body: Series<Byte>
) {
    fun toHttpMessage(): Series<Byte> {
        val statusLine = "HTTP/1.1 $statusCode $reasonPhrase\r\n"
        val headersStr = headers.map { (k, v) -> "$k: ${v.play.joinToString("")}" }.joinToString("\r\n")
        val bodyBytes = body ?: ByteArray(0).toSeries()
        val head = "$statusLine$headersStr\r\n\r\n".toSeries().map { it.code.toByte() }.toSeries()
        return head + bodyBytes
    }
}
```

                            else -> null

package borg.trikeshed.reactor

import borg.trikeshed.platform.AppDispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.Job
import kotlinx.coroutines.channels.Channel
import borg.trikeshed.platform.SelectorInterface

class Reactor(
    private val selector: SelectorInterface,
    private val reactions: MutableMap<SelectableChannel, AsyncReaction> = mutableMapOf(),
    private val job: Job = Job(),
    private val scope: CoroutineScope = CoroutineScope(job + AppDispatchers.IO),
    private val bufferPool: BufferPool = BufferPoolImpl()
) {
    private val commandChannel = Channel<Command>(Channel.UNLIMITED)

    init {
        start()
    }

    private fun start() {
        scope.launch {
            while (job.isActive) {
                selector.select()
                val selectedKeys = selector.selectedKeys()
                for (key in selectedKeys) {
                    val reaction = reactions[key.channel]
                    if (reaction != null) {
                        val newReaction = when {
                            key.isReadable() -> reaction.onRead(key)
                            key.isWritable() -> reaction.onWrite(key)
                            key.isConnectable() -> reaction.onConnect(key)
                            key.isAcceptable() -> reaction.onAccept(key)
                            else -> null
                        }
                        if (newReaction != null) {
                            reactions[key.channel] = newReaction
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    internal class BufferPoolImpl : BufferPool {
        override fun acquire(size: Int): Series<Byte> = TODO("Not yet implemented")
        override fun release(buffer: Series<Byte>) = TODO("Not yet implemented")
    }
}
```

package borg.trikeshed.reactor.http

import borg.trikeshed.reactor.AsyncReaction
import borg.trikeshed.reactor.SelectionKey
import borg.trikeshed.reactor.UnaryAsyncReaction

class HttpServer(private val port: Int) : UnaryAsyncReaction {
    private val serverChannel = ServerChannel()

    init {
        serverChannel.bind(port)
    }

    override fun onAccept(key: SelectionKey): AsyncReaction? {
        val clientChannel = key.channel.accept()
        return OP_ACCEPT()
    }

    override fun onRead(key: SelectionKey): AsyncReaction? {
        val buffer = ByteArray(1024)
        val read = key.channel.read(buffer.toSeries())
        return if (read > 0) {
            val request = parseRequest(buffer.sliceArray(0 until read))
            val response = handleRequest(request, key)
            OP_READ()
        } else {
            null
        }
    }

    private fun parseRequest(bytes: ByteArray): HttpRequest {
        val requestLine = bytes.toSeries().asString()
        return HttpRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.GET,
            path = HttpRequestPath("/"),
            headers = emptyMap(),
            body = bytes.toSeries()
        )
    }

    private fun handleRequest(request: HttpRequest, key: SelectionKey): AsyncReaction? {
        val response = "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Length: 12\r\n\r\nHello World!"
        key.channel.write(response.toByteArray())
        return null
    }
}
```

**Trikeshed/src/commonMain/kotlin/borg/trikeshed/reactor/HttpTypes.kt**
```
package borg.trikeshed.net.http

import borg.trikeshed.lib.Series

typealias HttpHeaders = Map<String, Series<Char>>

data class HttpRequest(
    val method: HttpMethod,
    val path: HttpRequestPath,
    val headers: HttpHeaders,
    val body: Series<Byte>
) {
    fun toHttpMessage(): Series<Byte> {
        val requestLine = "$method $path HTTP/1.1\r\n"
        val headersStr = headers.map { (k, v) -> "$k: ${v.play.joinToString("")}" }.joinToString("\r\n")
        val bodyBytes = body ?: ByteArray(0).toSeries()
        val head = "$requestLine$headersStr\r\n\r\n".toSeries().map { it.code.toByte() }.toSeries()
        return head + bodyBytes
    }
}

data class HttpResponse(
    val statusCode: Int,
    val reasonPhrase: String,
    val headers: HttpHeaders,
    val body: Series<Byte>
) {
    fun toHttpMessage(): Series<Byte> {
        val statusLine = "HTTP/1.1 $statusCode $reasonPhrase\r\n"
        val headersStr = headers.map { (k, v) -> "$k: ${v.play.joinToString("")}" }.joinToString("\r\n")
        val bodyBytes = body ?: ByteArray(0).toSeries()
        val head = "$statusLine$headersStr\r\n\r\n".toSeries().map { it.code.toByte() }.toSeries()
        return head + bodyBytes
    }
}
```

**Trikeshed/src/commonMain/kotlin/borg/trikeshed/reactor/Reactor.kt**
```
package borg.trikeshed.reactor

import borg.trikeshed.platform.AppDispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.Job
import kotlinx.coroutines.channels.Channel
import borg.trikeshed.platform.SelectorInterface

class Reactor(
    private val selector: SelectorInterface,
    private val reactions: MutableMap<SelectableChannel, AsyncReaction> = mutableMapOf(),
    private val job: Job = Job(),
    private val scope: CoroutineScope = CoroutineScope(job + AppDispatchers.IO),
    private val bufferPool: BufferPool = BufferPoolImpl()
) {
    private val commandChannel = Channel<Command>(Channel.UNLIMITED)

    init {
        start()
    }

    private fun start() {
        scope.launch {
            while (job.isActive) {
                selector.select()
                val selectedKeys = selector.selectedKeys()
                for (key in selectedKeys) {
                    val reaction = reactions[key.channel]
                    if (reaction != null) {
                        val newReaction = when {
                            key.isReadable() -> reaction.onRead(key)
                            key.isWritable() -> reaction.onWrite(key)
                            key.isConnectable() -> reaction.onConnect(key)
                            key.isAcceptable() -> reaction.onAccept(key)
                            else -> null
                        }
                        if (newReaction != null) {
                            reactions[key.channel] = newReaction
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    internal class BufferPoolImpl : BufferPool {
        override fun acquire(size: Int): Series<Byte> = TODO("Not yet implemented")
        override fun release(buffer: Series<Byte>) = TODO("Not yet implemented")
    }
}
```

**Trikeshed/src/commonMain/kotlin/borg/trikeshed/reactor/Reactor.kt**
```
package borg.trikeshed.reactor

import borg.trikeshed.platform.AppDispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.Job
import kotlinx.coroutines.channels.Channel
import borg.trikeshed.platform.SelectorInterface

class Reactor(
    private val selector: SelectorInterface,
    private val reactions: MutableMap<SelectableChannel, AsyncReaction> = mutableMapOf(),
    private val job: Job = Job(),
    private val scope: CoroutineScope = CoroutineScope(job + AppDispatchers.IO),
    private val bufferPool: BufferPool = BufferPoolImpl()
) {
    private val commandChannel = Channel<Command>(Channel.UNLIMITED)

    init {
        start()
    }

    private fun start() {
        scope.launch {
            while (job.isActive) {
                selector.select()
                val selectedKeys = selector.selectedKeys()
                for (key in selectedKeys) {
                    val reaction = reactions[key.channel]
                    if (reaction != null) {
                        val newReaction = when {
                            key.isReadable() -> reaction.onRead(key)
                            key.isWritable() -> reaction.onWrite(key)
                            key.isConnectable() -> reaction.onConnect(key)
                            key.isAcceptable() -> reaction.onAccept(key)
                            else -> null
                        }
                        if (newReaction != null) {
                            reactions[key.channel] = newReaction
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    internal class BufferPoolImpl : BufferPool {
        override fun acquire(size: Int): Series<Byte> = TODO("Not yet implemented")
        override fun release(buffer: Series<Byte>) = TODO("Not yet implemented")
    }
}
```

package borg.trikeshed.reactor.http

import borg.trikeshed.reactor.AsyncReaction
import borg.trikeshed.reactor.SelectionKey
import borg.trikeshed.reactor.UnaryAsyncReaction

class HttpServer(private val port: Int) : UnaryAsyncReaction {
    private val serverChannel = ServerChannel()

    init {
        serverChannel.bind(port)
    }

    override fun onAccept(key: SelectionKey): AsyncReaction? {
        val clientChannel = key.channel.accept()
        return OP_ACCEPT()
    }

    override fun onRead(key: SelectionKey): AsyncReaction? {
        val buffer = ByteArray(1024)
        val read = key.channel.read(buffer.toSeries())
        return if (read > 0) {
            val request = parseRequest(buffer.sliceArray(0 until read))
            val response = handleRequest(request, key)
            OP_READ()
        } else {
            null
        }
    }

    private fun parseRequest(bytes: ByteArray): HttpRequest {
        val requestLine = bytes.toSeries().asString()
        return HttpRequest(
            method = HttpMethod.GET,
            path = HttpRequestPath("/"),
            headers = emptyMap(),
            body = bytes.toSeries()
        )
    }

    private fun handleRequest(request: HttpRequest, key: SelectionKey): AsyncReaction? {
        val response = "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Length: 12\r\n\r\nHello World!"
        key.channel.write(response.toByteArray())
        return null
    }
}

package borg.trikeshed.net.http

import borg.trikeshed.lib.Series

typealias HttpHeaders = Map<String, Series<Char>>

data class HttpRequest(
    val method: HttpMethod,
    val path: HttpRequestPath,
    val headers: HttpHeaders,
    val body: Series<Byte>
) {
    fun toHttpMessage(): Series<Byte> {
        val requestLine = "$method $path HTTP/1.1\r\n"
        val headersStr = headers.map { (k, v) -> "$k: ${v.play.joinToString("")}" }.joinToString("\r\n")
        val bodyBytes = body ?: ByteArray(0).toSeries()
        val head = "$requestLine$headersStr\r\n\r\n".toSeries().map { it.code.toByte() }.toSeries()
        return head + bodyBytes
    }
}

data class HttpResponse(
    val statusCode: Int,
    val reasonPhrase: String,
    val headers: HttpHeaders,
    val body: Series<Byte>
) {
    fun toHttpMessage(): Series<Byte> {
        val statusLine = "HTTP/1.1 $statusCode $reasonPhrase\r\n"
        val headersStr = headers.map { (k, v) -> "$k: ${v.play.joinToString("")}" }.joinToString("\r\n")
        val bodyBytes = body ?: ByteArray(0).toSeries()
        val head = "$statusLine$headersStr\r\n\r\n".toSeries().map { it.code.toByte() }.toSeries()
        return head + bodyBytes
    }
}

**Trikeshed/src/commonMain/kotlin/borg/trikeshed/reactor/Reactor.kt**
```
package borg.trikeshed.reactor

import borg.trikeshed.platform.AppDispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.Job
import kotlinx.coroutines.channels.Channel
import borg.trikeshed.platform.SelectorInterface

class Reactor(
    private val selector: SelectorInterface,
    private val reactions: MutableMap<SelectableChannel, AsyncReaction> = mutableMapOf(),
    private val job: Job = Job(),
    private val scope: CoroutineScope = CoroutineScope(job + AppDispatchers.IO),
    private val bufferPool: BufferPool = BufferPoolImpl()
) {
    private val commandChannel = Channel<Command>(Channel.UNLIMITED)

    init {
        start()
    }

    private fun start() {
        scope.launch {
            while (job.isActive) {
                selector.select()
                val selectedKeys = selector.selectedKeys()
                for (key in selectedKeys) {
                    val reaction = reactions[key.channel]
                    if (reaction != null) {
                        val newReaction = when {
                            key.isReadable() -> reaction.onRead(key)
                            key.isWritable() -> reaction.onWrite(key)
                            key.isConnectable() -> reaction.onConnect(key)
                            key.isAcceptable() -> reaction.onAccept(key)
                            else -> null
                        }
                        if (newReaction != null) {
                            reactions[key.channel] = newReaction
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    internal class BufferPoolImpl : BufferPool {
        override fun acquire(size: Int): Series<Byte> = TODO("Not yet implemented")
        override fun release(buffer: Series<Byte>) = TODO("Not yet implemented")
    }
}
```
